entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Ibn Sina Mosque, also known as la mosque Avicenne and the Grande Mosquée Ibn Sina, named in honour of Avicenne, is a mosque located in the Petit Bard neighborhood of Montpellier, in the department of Hérault, in the South of France. The mosque is managed and run by a group of Algerian nationals from the Association for the Knowledge of Arab Culture.
